description: Source code for TransportSecurityPersister class handling serialization and persistence of transport security state data in JSON format, including encoding/decoding of hashed domain names and managing disk I/O.

classes.name: TransportSecurityPersister
classes.description: Manages serialization and persistence of transport security state data, including loading from and writing to disk asynchronously.

methods.name: TransportSecurityPersister
methods.description: Constructor initializing the persister with state, background runner, and data path, setting delegate and starting load process.

methods.name: ~TransportSecurityPersister
methods.description: Destructor, ensuring pending writes are completed and delegate is reset.

methods.name: StateIsDirty
methods.description: Marks the state as dirty, scheduling a write.

methods.name: WriteNow
methods.description: Immediately serializes and writes the current state to disk, with callback upon completion.

methods.name: OnWriteFinished
methods.description: Callback invoked after write completes, runs provided callback.

methods.name: SerializeData
methods.description: Serializes the current transport security state into a JSON string.

methods.name: LoadEntries
methods.description: Loads and deserializes state data from a JSON string.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Parses JSON string and updates the security state, handling versioning and legacy data.

methods.name: CompleteLoad
methods.description: Completes loading process with deserialized data.
